assessments.reasoning: The information required to evaluate how the anchor person for the household record is identified, the selection criteria for the reference person, and who responds to household-level questions is documented in the socio-demographic section of the survey instrument and Part 1 of the interviewer manual. Those document sections were not supplied in this run, as only Part 2 of 2 of the interviewer manual (covering Labor Batteries III through XI) was provided.
